lines.text: After three months, Paul's group sailed in an Alexandrian ship, stopped at Syracuse for three days, and reached Puteoli.
Brothers in Puteoli invited the group to stay a week, and believers from Rome met Paul at the Forum of Appius.
In Rome, Paul stayed by himself with a soldier guarding him, and he told the Jewish leaders he appealed to Pharaoh.
Paul taught from morning to evening using the Law of Moses and the Prophets, and some people were convinced while others refused to believe.
Paul said God's salvation was sent to the Pharisees, and he stayed two full years in his rented house.
